rubric_items.reason: Built on the existing repo, service, route, types, page and format.ts. not_seen is now parsed in the service, like with_today (prior F-1 resolved). CO-6 still marks client.ts changed, but api.patients already forwards any params.

S-1 to S-6 all map to components. The local-today cutoff, calendar-month clamping, COMPLETED-only join, never-visited exclusion, and the filter applied to both the page and count queries cover every AC.

Every EP-1 field has a name, type, nullability, format and example. Inside the API it is unclear which layer turns starts_at into last_visit.date (the repo maps rows today), and the page filters object that must carry not_seen is not named.
Choices are cited or decided by A-05 to A-08, and nothing is invented. C14's line that the flag is added in client.ts does not match the code, where the page builds the params.
Trade-offs are given for the lateral join, the service-side cutoff, clamping, service-side parsing and the page reset, each with its cost.
Clear and consistent. The overview, components, EP-1 fields and story coverage agree with each other.
